title: Company Headquarters at "Thom Son Nuht"
description: Larry remembers his Company Headquarters at a place whose name the family transcribes phonetically as "Thom Son Nuht." The leading research hypothesis is Tân Sơn Nhứt (Tan Son Nhut) air base near Saigon, but the identification is unconfirmed.
larrysRecollection: Larry remembers a location phonetically as "Thom Son Nuht." He remembers this as a Company Headquarters location.
researchNotes: See the place entry for the full identification hypothesis and cautions.
